domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert to fractions
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers and whole numbers as equivalent fractions (often improper, or with a specified denominator) to enable fraction subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: A step converts a mixed number a b/c into an improper fraction (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites an integer n as an equivalent fraction n·d/d to match a needed denominator
A step simplifies a mixed number’s fractional part before conversion (e.g., 3 4/10 → 3 2/5) as part of preparing for subtraction
exclusion_criteria: A step only finds/chooses a common denominator between two fractions without converting any mixed/whole number
A step only reduces/simplifies the result after subtraction

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step computes/chooses a common denominator (e.g., using LCM of denominators)
A step scales numerator and denominator to form equivalent fractions with the chosen common denominator
A step converts both quantities to a shared denominator explicitly before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed
A step only converts mixed numbers/integers to fractions without addressing denominator alignment between the two quantities

skills.name: Subtract rationals
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed in compatible forms (e.g., same denominator or separated whole and fractional parts), including recognizing zero results.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts by separating whole and fractional parts (e.g., (3−3) + (4/5−2/5))
A step recognizes exact cancellation to 0 (e.g., 7/2 − 7/2 or 2/3 − 2/3)
exclusion_criteria: A step only performs conversions (mixed/whole to fraction, or finding a common denominator) without executing subtraction
A step only reduces/simplifies or converts the final result form after subtraction

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed fraction to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer or mixed number) consistent with the computed value.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor (e.g., 21/12 → 7/4)
A step states/recognizes the fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or an integer for final reporting (or notes the equivalent form)
exclusion_criteria: A step only finds a common denominator or creates equivalent fractions (pre-subtraction work)
A step only performs the subtraction operation without any reduction or final-form conversion
